author: ojiudezue
title: Measurement day: A-2/A-3 reverted on consumer-count, senscap through 4 Tier-3 reviews, duty-cycle saga = 4 retractions, forcing-function ladder shipped
summary: A day defined by measurement beating mechanism-guessing, both ways. RESACC-1 measured the resolver (39/39 recall, 0 precision violations, near-miss clean) and its 'fix' for A-2/A-3 passed 2 of 3 reviews before Review B asked the question nobody had: who consumes this value? Answer: one caller, on the other code path — reverted by operator decision, strict xfails retained. SENSOR-CAPABILITY-1 (capability vs role split) built, rebased off a 214-commit-stale worktree base, survived 4 framing-disjoint reviews where B/C/D DISAGREED about one line and the disagreement itself was the signal (D's HIGH was real but mis-attributed; both its proposed fixes would have been no-ops). Evening HVAC episode: 4 successive wrong mechanisms asserted from snapshots before the ledger + hvac_const.py settled it as ONE duty-cycle limiter cycling by design (coast = 15min/20min window); real defects are narrower (off-phase setpoint parks at ambient; kids' manual cooling arrested with no comfort exemption). BOARD-CURRENCY-1 rungs 1-2 shipped: deploy.sh --cards gate + vibememo chain, so this entry class becomes release-coupled. Detector triage: D1 correctly rare (keep), P24 structurally blind (fix approved), D3 structurally unreachable (kill approved). Restarts = our deploys (25/26 map to releases; 0 spurious).
decisions: Revert A-2/A-3 canonical-area precedence: zero live consumers for the benefit, one real regression path on the only live consumer (transit_validator), and 39 recently-corrected camera areas prove wrong-area is the common state here. Keep the strict=True xfails as the executable record.

Take the P15 dedup I1 deviation (Reviewer B adjudication): substrate already normalises multi-list entities by the same precedence; preserving the double-scoring bug for byte-identity would certify a defect.

DROP D1/D3/P24 from the ledger migration set (operator). Ledger reduces to M1/M3/M5/M7. Criterion 3 satisfied via incident memo; criterion 4 amended: offline replay harness replaces the runtime tap, fixtures must be REGENERATED after any cycle that changes a migrated site.

Duty-cycle flap: measure-first gate before any build. Probe verdict: long-standing, not a regression (flat-to-declining across 31 days, coast pinned at ~4h/day); the real defect is unrecoverable-load oscillation (zone_2 never converging), one episode in 3 days, not the 8.8/day headline.
SENSOR-CAPABILITY-1 deploy deferred to morning: value activates on declaration not deploy, and a restart at midnight after the HVAC episode buys nothing.
alternatives_considered: Patching A-2/A-3 around B1 (same-integration outer restriction / sibling agreement / kill switch) — each fails on merit: the first two cannot fix A-3 at all, the third is containment machinery that evidences the risk it discounts.
ruamel.yaml for the kanban writer — rejected: not installed, and a pip dependency in the release path is worse than the reflow bug. Parse-to-validate, edit-as-text won.
Raising recorder retention for ledger fixtures — rejected: binding constraint is event rate, not history (the short buckets are short because the events never happen).

Arbitration rule between 'two HVAC writers' — dissolved: there is one writer; the framing was wrong. Candidate fixes narrowed to off-phase setpoint offset (cheapest, helps every episode), damping, unrecoverable-load detection.
implications: A defect's severity is a property of its CONSUMERS, not of the data. Codified in the kanban skill: count the consumers before fixing the defect; None is often safer than a wrong value; a measurement licenses only what it measured.

Framing-disjoint review earns its cost in a new way: three reviewers disagreeing about one line, where adjudication required source-reading, produced the correct disposition none of them held individually.
Verify the worktree BASE, not just its isolation — a green suite 214 commits behind reads as evidence and is worse than red.
When an instrument built for exactly this question returns nothing, suspect the query before the instrument (details vs details_json: nearly filed a defect against a working ledger).
For any 'it keeps doing X' complaint, pull state HISTORY before proposing a mechanism — four successive snapshot-mechanisms died on the next fact.
The board update is now an OUTPUT of shipping (deploy.sh --cards), not a task beside it. Vibememo is chained to the same gate, so this entry's lateness class self-extinguishes.
confidence: high on the decisions; medium on duty-cycle fix direction (off-phase setpoint) pending operator marginal-benefit call
revisit_trigger: If the zone_2-style non-converging oscillation recurs before the off-phase setpoint question is decided, or if senscap live validation post-deploy shows any I1 drift with zero declarations.
